description: This source file defines the GameView class for a Tic Tac Toe game, handling rendering, touch interactions, game state management, and visual updates within an Android application.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: Custom View for rendering and managing the Tic Tac Toe game grid, handling user interactions, and maintaining game state.

methods.name: GameView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the game view, setting up resources, paints, and initial game state.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current game grid data as an array of states.

methods.name: setCell
methods.description: Sets the state of a specific cell in the grid.

methods.name: setCellListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for cell selection events.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently selected cell or -1 if none is selected.

methods.name: getCurrentPlayer
methods.description: Returns the current player whose turn it is.

methods.name: setFinished
methods.description: Marks the game as finished with winning row, column, or diagonal.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Custom drawing logic for rendering the game grid, pieces, and winning lines.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Ensures the view remains square based on the provided size.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates size and position for drawing based on view dimensions.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input for selecting cells.

methods.name: stopBlink
methods.description: Stops the blinking indicator on the selected cell.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state for configuration changes.

methods.name: getResBitmap
methods.description: Helper for loading bitmap resources with fallback for IDE rendering.
